responsibility: Implements text-diagnostic support for explaining macro-expansion provenance. It walks libcpp macro line maps from an expanded token back through nested expansions, decides when to show definition versus expansion contexts, and emits note diagnostics such as “in definition of macro” and “in expansion of macro”, providing the finalizer logic that front ends using libcpp can invoke to append macro-unwinding traces after the primary message.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the macro-unwinding pair: unlike gcc/diagnostic-macro-unwinding.h, which only declares the entry points, it contains the libcpp line-map traversal that reconstructs nested macro expansion traces and emits the corresponding text notes.
